full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the instant civil petition for leave to appeal are that the pre-emptor (petitioner herein) filed pre-emption Miscellaneous Case No. 42 of 2004 before the Assistant Judge, Third Court, Gazipur, stating, inter alia, that the petitioner is a co-sharer in R.S. plot no. 5116 of R.S. Khatian No. 231 corresponding to S.A. Plot No. 1419 of S.A. Khatian No. 316 of Mouza Uzuli under Police Station Kapasia, Gazipur by dint of registered sale deed No. 618 dated 22.8.1978 and registered heba deed dated 27.03.2001 executed by recorded tenant. Another co-sharer respondent No. 2, Most. Ramija khatun, by a registered deed dated 29.01.2004 sold the case land for a price of Tk. 16,000/- to a stranger the pre-emptee Abdul Malek Molla.
